description: This file defines an Android activity class 'PlayerActivity' responsible for user interface interactions and controlling music playback via a bound service 'MusicService'. It manages UI components such as play/pause, next, previous, repeat, shuffle, and equalizer buttons, as well as a seek bar for track position. The activity observes the music service for current song updates and playback status to update the UI accordingly.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing the music player UI and binding to a music playback service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method initializing views, setting up service connection, and starting the music service.

methods.name: initializeViews
methods.description: Finds UI components by their IDs.

methods.name: setupService
methods.description: Configures the music service with the playlist when connected.

methods.name: setupObservers
methods.description: Sets up LiveData observers for current song and playback state to update UI.

methods.name: setupClickListeners
methods.description: Assigns actions to control buttons for playback, navigation, repeat, shuffle, and equalizer.

methods.name: setupSeekBar
methods.description: Configures the seek bar to reflect the current position and allow seeking in the track.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Clean-up method unbinding the service and removing handler callbacks.
